embeds.description: Reason : I would like to know how to do case studies for MongoDB. I am trying to figure out where to access databases and how to submit case studies. Any link or document to explain this would be really helpful.

messages.author: jinalgupta.
messages.content:
<@1099898271985586198> Ma'am, 
Unless explicitly mentioned, MongoDB case studies can be completed and tested using MongoDB Compass or MongoDB Atlas. A full backend setup is not mandatory.
You can simply send the queries you used to implement the same.
